candidate.source_summary: The url variable is sourced from either the instance's webhook_url attribute (which can be set via Django settings) or from get_request_uri(request), which constructs a URL including any basic authentication credentials present in the request.
candidate.sink_summary: The constructed url is used as part of the signed_data for HMAC signature validation. It is also included in an error message if signature validation fails.
candidate.guard_summary: The security control is the HMAC signature validation using webhook_key, which ensures that only requests with a valid signature (computed over the url and POST parameters) are accepted. The basic auth credentials in the URL are part of the signed data, so they must match what Mandrill used when signing.
candidate.risk_pattern: If webhook_url is set to an attacker-controlled value, it could be used to manipulate the HMAC signature validation by changing the URL that gets signed. However, if webhook_url is not explicitly set, get_request_uri(request) is used which includes basic auth credentials from the request, making the signature dependent on those credentials.
